FACT-1.gloss: Carla's normal download speed is 2 GB per minute

FACT-2.gloss: The file Carla is downloading is 200 GB

FACT-3.gloss: Carla had downloaded 40% of the file before the restart

OP-2.gloss: 80 GB divided by 2 GB/min is 40 minutes

OP-3.gloss: 200 GB divided by 2 GB/min is 100 minutes

RULE-1.gloss: If x's file size is n and x had downloaded fraction p before the restart, and p times n equals v, then the volume x must redo before the restart is v

RULE-2.gloss: If x must download volume v for the before-restart segment at speed s, and v divided by s equals t, then it takes x t minutes for that segment

RULE-3.gloss: If x's file size is n and x's speed is s, and n divided by s equals t, then it takes x t minutes to download the whole file again after the restart

RULE-4.gloss: If x's before-restart time is t1 and x's after-restart time is t2, and t1 plus t2 equals t, then x's total time is t
RULE-4.verify_reason: Total time should include the 20-minute restart/update delay, but this rule only sums the before-restart and after-restart download times, omitting the 20 minutes entirely.

INF-1.gloss: The volume Carla must redo before the restart is 80 GB, from FACT-2, FACT-3, OP-1, and RULE-1 by Universal Instantiation and Modus Ponens

INF-2.gloss: It takes Carla 40 minutes for the before-restart segment, from INF-1, FACT-1, OP-2, and RULE-2 by Universal Instantiation and Modus Ponens

INF-3.gloss: It takes Carla 100 minutes for the after-restart segment, from FACT-2, FACT-1, OP-3, and RULE-3 by Universal Instantiation and Modus Ponens

INF-4.gloss: Carla's total download time is 140 minutes, from INF-2, INF-3, OP-4, and RULE-4 by Universal Instantiation and Modus Ponens

errors.message: Total time should include the 20-minute restart/update delay, but this rule only sums the before-restart and after-restart download times, omitting the 20 minutes entirely.
